name: @gdg/backend
description: GDG Challenges HTTP API (Fastify + TypeScript, feature-based modules)

scriptNotes.dev: Starts the backend with tsx watch and loads apps/backend/.env when present.
scriptNotes.build: Compiles backend TypeScript from src/ into dist/.
scriptNotes.start: Runs the compiled backend from dist/ with apps/backend/.env when present.
scriptNotes.db:up: Starts the local Docker PostgreSQL container and waits for its health check.
scriptNotes.db:down: Stops the local Docker PostgreSQL container and preserves its volume; succeeds harmlessly when Docker is not running.
scriptNotes.db:reset: Destructively recreates the local Docker database and applies migrations using the local connection string.
scriptNotes.db:setup: Applies pending Drizzle migrations to DATABASE_URL without starting Docker.
scriptNotes.db:local-setup: Starts local Docker PostgreSQL and applies migrations without using a hosted DATABASE_URL.
scriptNotes.db:local-seed: Loads seed data into local Docker PostgreSQL without using a hosted DATABASE_URL.
scriptNotes.db:generate: Generates a Drizzle migration after a *.table.ts schema change; review and commit the generated files.
scriptNotes.db:migrate: Applies pending generated migrations to DATABASE_URL.
scriptNotes.db:seed: Loads database/seeds/seed.sql into DATABASE_URL; intended for an empty development database.
scriptNotes.db:clear: Clears development rows from DATABASE_URL only with --confirm and refuses NODE_ENV=production.
scriptNotes.typecheck: Checks backend TypeScript without writing dist/.
